description: This file contains the implementation of the TestTpm class, which initializes and finalizes a TPM (Trusted Platform Module) context using the TSS2 library. It includes methods for setting up and accessing the ESYS_CONTEXT used for TPM operations.

classes.name: TestTpm
classes.description: A class that manages TPM context initialization and cleanup, providing an interface to interact with the TPM hardware.

methods.name: TestTpm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TPM context using Esys_Initialize.

methods.name: ~TestTpm
methods.description: Destructor that finalizes the TPM context using Esys_Finalize.

methods.name: Esys
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ESYS_CONTEXT for TPM operations.
